description.value: C Market Coffee takes its name from the global commodity exchange where Arabica coffee is traded, and the Port Coquitlam location is part of a growing BC chain that roasts micro-lot beans in-house and pairs them with fresh, thoughtfully crafted food in a design-forward space. Beyond espresso drinks, the café offers matcha, loose-leaf tea, coffee classes, pop-up markets, and room rental, functioning as a genuine community hub rather than just a quick-stop café. Cyclists will find a full food menu with published nutrition and allergen guides, and a mobile app for ordering ahead.
